analysis:
The two supplied units are BASE-side excerpts of docs/threat-model.yaml (base lines 1396-2337) covering T-041 tail, T-033 through T-059, and ending at T-059 (base lines 2306-2337). The PR changes only this documentation file: a header comment (head 46-49), TB-012 rewrite (mailbox, accept-time peer checks, socket override, self-reported busy fields, fail-open hold record), T-059 model-load fence additions, and a new T-060 (starving the add-on socket, stalling control-file reads). The patch excerpt is truncated and the head-side text was not supplied, so I could not verify the new TB-012 or T-060 prose against any code. No source or security control changes are visible; this is documentation-only.

From the base text the only changed region in these units is T-059 (base 2323-2327, 2337). The base mitigations claim a per-request audit-token signature check, bounded framing, leases with a machine-lock fallback, persisted holds, and operator release via `darkbloom addon release`. The PR appears to extend these to an accept-time peer check and a mailbox. I cannot confirm that claim without the head text. The new statements that busy fields are self-reported and the hold record is fail-open describe accepted residual risk. Whether they are tracked as open or accepted, and whether T-060 has mitigations marked implemented that the code does not enforce, needs a pass over the head-side text and the referenced Swift files (AddonPeerPolicy, AddonIPCServer, ProviderLoop+AddonHold, ProviderDrain).

No regression is identified in the supplied evidence. I set needs_deeper_review=true because the head content for TB-012, T-059 and T-060 was not provided and the accuracy of those claims against the code is unverified.
